172.meaning1: unseasonable flower; blossom appearing out of season

examples.text: sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.

173.meaning1: out of season rain shower; unseasonal downpour

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ, tam'enaṃ mahāakālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

175.meaning1: who speaks at the improper time; who talks out of turn
175.meaningLit: not speaking at the right time
175.commentary: (MNa) akālavādī'ti akālena vattā. (ANa) akālavādī'ti kālasmiṃ na vadati, akālasmiṃ vadati nāma.

examples.text: evarūpo c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo vuccati akālavādī'ti'pi, abhūtavādī'ti'pi, anatthavādī'ti'pi, adhammavādī'ti'pi, avinayavādī'ti'pi.
samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

176.construction:
na > a + √kal > kāl + *a + ika
akāla + ika
176.commentary: (SNa) attano phaladānaṃ sandhāya n'āssa kālo'ti akālo, akālo'y'eva akāliko.

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
iminā tvaṃ dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atīt'ānāgate nayaṃ nehi

177.meaning1: timeless; not limited to a particular time
177.construction:
na > a + √kal > kāl + *a + ika
akāla + ika

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
so navañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, purāṇañ'ca kammaṃ phussa phussa byantīkaroti, sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.

178.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of na kāla, neg
178.meaning1: at the wrong time; at an unsuitable occasion
178.meaning2: not at the right time, at an unsuitable time; at night; out of season
178.construction:
na > a + √kal > kāl + *a + e
akāla + e

examples.text: akkh'itthiyo vāruṇī naccagītaṃ, divā soppaṃ pāricariyā akāle, pāpā ca mittā sukadariyatā ca, ete cha ṭhānā purisaṃ dhaṃsayanti.
akāle vassatī tassa, kāle tassa na vassati, saggā ca cavati ṭhānā, nanu so tāvatā hato'ti.

179.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of na kāla, neg
179.meaning1: at the wrong moment; at an unsuitable time; at an improper time
179.construction:
na > a + √kal > kāl + *a + ena
akāla + ena
179.commentary: (MNa) akālenā'ti vattabbakālassa pubbe vā pacchā vā ayuttakāle vattā hoti. (ANa) akālenā'ti kathetuṃ ayuttakālena. (ANa) saṅghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā salāk'agga-yāg'agga-vitakkamāḷaka-bhikkhācāramagga-āsanasāl'ādīsu vā upaṭṭhākehi parivāritakkhaṇe vā codento akālena vadati nāma.

examples.text: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā

pañc'ime, bhikkhave, vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ, kālena vā akālena vā, bhūtena vā abhūtena vā, saṇhena vā pharusena vā, atthasaṃhitena vā anatthasaṃhitena vā, mettacittā vā dos'antarā vā.
alaṃdāni, ānanda. mā tathāgataṃ yāci, akālo'dāni, ānanda, tathāgataṃ yācanāyā'ti.
katvā'pi te, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ tadeva te kāyakammaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, yaṃ nu kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ akāsiṃ idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati
adāsi me akāsi me, ñātimittā sakhā ca me. petānaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ dajjā, pubbe katam'anussaraṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu andham'akāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato.
m'āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyam'ev'āyasmā attānaṃ karotu, āyasmā'pi bhikkhū vadatu sahadhammena, bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena

183.meaning1: not from Kāsi; i.e. of inferior quality
183.construction:
na > a + kāsi + ka
akāsi + ka

examples.text: na kho pan'ass'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, akāsikaṃ candanaṃ dhāremi. kāsikaṃ, bhikkhave, su me taṃ veṭhanaṃ hoti, kāsikā kañcukā, kāsikaṃ nivāsanaṃ, kāsiko uttarāsaṅgo.

ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ. kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilanto. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti. so nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ, bhante, pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ, yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomī'ti.
so'haṃ yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantī akāsiṃ
so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, yo c'āyaṃ kāmavitakko yo ca byāpādavitakko yo ca vihiṃsāvitakko, imaṃ ekaṃ bhāgam'akāsiṃ

186.grammar: nt, ptp of na karoti, neg
186.meaning1: (something which) should not be done; ought not to be made

examples.text: yañ'hi kiccaṃ apaviddhaṃ, akiccaṃ pana karīyati, unnaḷānaṃ pamattānaṃ, tesaṃ vaḍḍhanti āsavā.
yesañ'ca susamāraddhā, niccaṃ kāyagatā sati, akiccaṃ te na sevanti, kicce sātaccakārino, satānaṃ sampajānānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.

187.meaning1: doing what should not be done; acting wrongly

examples.text: bhavaṃ kho pana rājā evaṃ sakaṇṭake janapade sauppīḷe balimuddhareyya, akiccakārī assa tena bhavaṃ rājā.

tatr'idaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti bhikkhācariyaṃ, bhikkhācariyañ'ca pana brāhmaṇo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopo'va adinnaṃ ādiyamāno'ti. idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.

188.meaning1: not doing one's duty; not fulfilling one's obligations

189.meaning1: not difficult; trouble-free; easy to get
189.commentary: (DNa) akicchalābhī'ti adukkhalābhī. (MNa) akicchalābhī'ti sukhen'eva paccanīkadhamme vikkhambhetvā samāpajjituṃ samattho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: imesañ'ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
dhanañ'ca puttaṃ bhariyañ'ca, chaḍḍayitvāna niggatā, kaṭacchubhikkhahetū'pi, akicchāni nisevare.

190.meaning1: who gains without trouble; obtaining without difficulty

examples.text: imesañ'ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… catunnañ'ca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.

191.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of na kiccha, neg
191.construction:
na > a + kiccha + ena
akiccha + ena

examples.text: sace enti manussattaṃ, aḍḍhe ājāyare kule, coḷaṃ piṇḍo ratī khiḍḍā, yattha-akicchena labbhati.

192.meaning1: with nothing; is nothing; having nothing; possession-less; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: na c'āhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brūmi, yonijaṃ mattisambhavaṃ, bhovādi nāma so hoti, sace hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum'ābhijaññā, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham'imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṅkho.

194.meaning1: insisting on no property; adhering to nothing

195.grammar: pron, nom & acc sg of na kaci, neg
195.construction: na > a + ka > ki + iṃ + ci

examples.text: na brāhmaṇass'etadakiñci seyyo, yadā nisedho manaso piyehi, yato yato hiṃsamano nivattati, tato tato sammati'm'eva dukkhaṃ.
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, kathaṃ nu dhīrā vitaranti oghaṃ, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, taṃ me muni sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, ettāvat'aggaṃ nu vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam'pi vadanti etto.

198.grammar: fem, abstr, from na kitteti, neg
198.commentary: (DNa) akittisañjananī'ti suraṃ pivitvā hi mātaram'pi paharanti pitaram'pi, aññaṃ bahum'pi avattabbaṃ vadanti, akattabbaṃ karonti. tena garaham'pi daṇḍam'pi hatthapādādichedampi pāpuṇanti, idhaloke'pi paraloke'pi akittiṃ pāpuṇanti, iti tesaṃ sā surā akittisañjananī nāma hoti.

examples.text: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge. sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, kalahappavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akittisañjananī, kopīnanidaṃsanī, paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'tv'eva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.
